svg.title: HarborCare improved flow
svg.desc: Role gate, verification, workflow routing, searchable appointments and synthetic sensitive-card transfer boundaries.
svg.text: HarborCare lab: updated flow / October 18, 2026
Connect: hosted text / WebRTC / phone
Native call start; synthetic data only. Phone remains separately configured.
NEW: caller role + patient ID + sensitive code
Only self is accepted. Representative or absent role is denied.
Backend verifies the account
Every read, booking and debit rechecks the authorized session.
Choose coverage / claims / appointments / billing / payment
NEW: competitive intent choices; switch suggestions have no side effects.
Appointments: searchable future slots
NEW: DatetimeFilter results intersect the available catalog before booking.
Payments: positive cents + consent + method
Decline means no debit. Choose demo_token or synthetic_card.
NEW: designated synthetic PAN + CVV fields
Guava hosted dialogue -> sensitive fields -> local fixture validator.
Local synthetic processor returns a masked receipt
Only last_four=1111 and synthetic status enter qa_result; no real gateway.
Backend simulates debit once; speaks result; ends
Session cleanup revokes access. Logs record limited outcomes.
NEW side paths: refusal / cancel / human / SDK questions
Caller-speech tripwire revokes representative access; human queue unavailable.
Sensitive is a field flag, not a verified retention or transcript-redaction guarantee.
Historical findings remain open unless the relevant behavior has been independently retested.
